title: Very disappointed
text: Very disappointed. I had purchased this bean bag as a present for my grandson. He is has needs that are in demand of him being comfortable with convenience. When this bag was delivered I was extremely disappointed in how this product was made and unable to be used.  The picture shows a adult sitting in the chair but that is not at all possible.  The packing foam is extremely large with way too many plus the material that is covering is the fabric backpacks are made of.  I of course have it ready to be returned and I will now have to find another place that has what I want and sadly my grandson will be getting his present late due to this purchase being  so upsetting
